question: Combien de clients avons-nous par segment ?
sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS nb_clients FROM clients GROUP BY segment ORDER BY nb_clients DESC

question: Combien de clients ont des conditions de paiement à 60 jours ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_clients FROM clients WHERE payment_terms_days = 60

question: Combien de factures ont été émises depuis le début de l'année ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_factures FROM invoices WHERE issued_on >= date(:today, 'start of year') AND status <> 'cancelled'

question: Quel est le montant moyen HT des factures du mois en cours ?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount_ht), 2) AS montant_moyen_ht FROM invoices WHERE issued_on >= date(:today, 'start of month') AND status <> 'cancelled'

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires HT mois par mois depuis janvier ?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', issued_on) AS mois, ROUND(SUM(amount_ht), 2) AS ca_ht FROM invoices WHERE issued_on >= date(:today, 'start of year') AND status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY mois ORDER BY mois

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires HT par région commerciale cette année ?
sql: SELECT r.region, ROUND(SUM(i.amount_ht), 2) AS ca_ht FROM invoices i JOIN clients c ON c.id = i.client_id JOIN sales_reps r ON r.id = c.sales_rep_id WHERE i.issued_on >= date(:today, 'start of year') AND i.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY ca_ht DESC

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires HT par commercial le mois dernier ?
sql: SELECT r.full_name, ROUND(SUM(i.amount_ht), 2) AS ca_ht FROM invoices i JOIN clients c ON c.id = i.client_id JOIN sales_reps r ON r.id = c.sales_rep_id WHERE i.issued_on >= date(:today, 'start of month', '-1 month') AND i.issued_on < date(:today, 'start of month') AND i.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY r.full_name ORDER BY ca_ht DESC

question: Quels sont les 10 clients qui ont passé le plus de commandes cette année ?
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS nb_commandes FROM orders o JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.client_id WHERE o.order_date >= date(:today, 'start of year') AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC LIMIT 10

question: Quelle est la marge brute par catégorie de produits ce mois-ci ?
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price - ol.unit_cost)), 2) AS marge_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = ol.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= date(:today, 'start of month') AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY marge_eur DESC

question: Quel est le taux de marge brute global depuis le début de l'année ?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price - ol.unit_cost)) / SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price), 1) AS taux_marge_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= date(:today, 'start of year') AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

question: Combien de commandes ont été annulées le mois dernier ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_annulees FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= date(:today, 'start of month', '-1 month') AND order_date < date(:today, 'start of month')

question: Quels clients actifs n'ont rien commandé depuis six mois ?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.client_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= date(:today, '-6 months')) ORDER BY c.name

question: Quel est le délai moyen de paiement par segment de client ?
sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(julianday(p.paid_on) - julianday(i.issued_on)), 1) AS delai_moyen_jours FROM invoices i JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = i.client_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours DESC

question: Quels sont les 5 produits qui ont rapporté le plus de marge depuis janvier ?
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price - ol.unit_cost)), 2) AS marge_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = ol.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= date(:today, 'start of year') AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY marge_eur DESC LIMIT 5

question: Quel montant TTC avons-nous facturé sur les 30 derniers jours ?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_ttc), 2) AS montant_ttc FROM invoices WHERE issued_on > date(:today, '-30 days') AND status <> 'cancelled'

question: Combien de factures sont partiellement payées ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_factures FROM invoices WHERE status = 'partially_paid'

question: Combien reste-t-il à encaisser sur les factures partiellement payées ?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.amount_ttc - COALESCE(p.paye, 0)), 2) AS reste_ttc FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, SUM(amount) AS paye FROM payments GROUP BY invoice_id) p ON p.invoice_id = i.id WHERE i.status = 'partially_paid'

question: Liste les commerciaux avec leur région et leur date d'embauche.
sql: SELECT full_name, region, hired_on FROM sales_reps ORDER BY hired_on

question: Qui sont les contacts du client Brasserie Lemaire ?
sql: SELECT ct.full_name, ct.role, ct.email FROM contacts ct JOIN clients c ON c.id = ct.client_id WHERE c.name = 'Brasserie Lemaire'

question: Dans quelles villes avons-nous le plus de clients ?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS nb_clients FROM clients GROUP BY city ORDER BY nb_clients DESC LIMIT 10

question: Quels produits retirés du catalogue ont encore été vendus cette année ?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE p.active = 0 AND o.order_date >= date(:today, 'start of year') ORDER BY p.name

question: Quel est le prix catalogue moyen par catégorie de produits ?
sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS prix_moyen FROM products WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC

question: Quels clients paient en moyenne au-delà de leurs conditions de paiement ?
sql: SELECT c.name, c.payment_terms_days, ROUND(AVG(julianday(p.paid_on) - julianday(i.issued_on)), 1) AS delai_moyen_jours FROM invoices i JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = i.client_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.payment_terms_days HAVING AVG(julianday(p.paid_on) - julianday(i.issued_on)) > c.payment_terms_days ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours DESC

question: Combien de commandes par statut depuis le début du trimestre ?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date(:today, 'start of month', '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', :today) AS INTEGER) - 1) % 3) || ' months') GROUP BY status ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC

question: Quelle part du chiffre d'affaires HT de l'année réalisent nos 10 premiers clients ?
sql: WITH ca AS (SELECT client_id, SUM(amount_ht) AS ca_ht FROM invoices WHERE issued_on >= date(:today, 'start of year') AND status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY client_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(ca_ht) FROM (SELECT ca_ht FROM ca ORDER BY ca_ht DESC LIMIT 10)) / SUM(ca_ht), 1) AS part_top10_pct FROM ca

question: Comment évolue le nombre de commandes sur les six derniers mois ?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS mois, COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date(:today, 'start of month', '-5 months') GROUP BY mois ORDER BY mois

question: Quels clients ont une facture échue depuis plus de 30 jours ?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM invoices i JOIN clients c ON c.id = i.client_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' AND i.due_on < date(:today, '-30 days') ORDER BY c.name

question: Quel moyen de paiement nos clients utilisent-ils le plus ?
sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS nb_paiements, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS montant FROM payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY nb_paiements DESC

question: Combien avons-nous encaissé le mois dernier ?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS encaisse FROM payments WHERE paid_on >= date(:today, 'start of month', '-1 month') AND paid_on < date(:today, 'start of month')

question: Quels secteurs d'activité ont le meilleur taux de marge depuis le début du trimestre ?
sql: SELECT c.sector, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price - ol.unit_cost)) / SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price), 1) AS taux_marge_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.client_id WHERE o.order_date >= date(:today, 'start of month', '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', :today) AS INTEGER) - 1) % 3) || ' months') AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY taux_marge_pct DESC

question: Combien de références compte chaque catégorie du catalogue ?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS nb_produits FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY nb_produits DESC

question: Quelle quantité moyenne commande-t-on par ligne dans chaque catégorie ?
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(AVG(ol.quantity), 1) AS quantite_moyenne FROM order_lines ol JOIN products p ON p.id = ol.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY quantite_moyenne DESC

question: Quel commercial suit le plus de grandes entreprises ?
sql: SELECT r.full_name, COUNT(c.id) AS nb_clients FROM clients c JOIN sales_reps r ON r.id = c.sales_rep_id WHERE c.segment = 'GE' GROUP BY r.id, r.full_name ORDER BY nb_clients DESC LIMIT 1

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires HT du même trimestre l'an dernier ?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_ht), 2) AS ca_ht FROM invoices WHERE issued_on >= date(date(:today, 'start of month', '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', :today) AS INTEGER) - 1) % 3) || ' months'), '-1 year') AND issued_on < date(date(:today, 'start of month', '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', :today) AS INTEGER) - 1) % 3) || ' months'), '-9 months') AND status <> 'cancelled'

question: Quels clients avons-nous créés depuis le 1er janvier ?
sql: SELECT name, segment, created_at FROM clients WHERE created_at >= date(:today, 'start of year') ORDER BY created_at

question: Combien de lignes contient une commande en moyenne ?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(nb_lignes), 1) AS lignes_par_commande FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS nb_lignes FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id)
